submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 at 25 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 90.334% among all candidate algorithms and threshold combinations tested. This represents a significant improvement of 6.324 percentage points over Algorithm-L1's best performance (84.01% at 30 GeV) and 16.832 percentage points over Algorithm-L3's best performance (73.502% at 40 GeV). All three algorithms meet the hard latency requirement of 4.0 μs, and the recommended threshold of 25 GeV falls within the allowed range of 20-60 GeV. The selection maximizes signal efficiency as required by the task goal while satisfying all constraints.
